report.summary: Completed and validated the carried-over milestone: the `read_clipboard` capability (the read half of the clipboard trio). Jarvis can now read the device clipboard's current text - 'read the code I just copied' / 'what did I just copy' - and feed it into a later step via a `captures`/`{{name}}` variable. It is opt-in (off by default, since the clipboard can hold a password), gated both in the executor and the planner prompt, and honest (an empty/non-text clipboard is a failure, never a blank success). Also fixed a forward-compat break: `main` HEAD (#93) did not compile because `OmniAgentApplication` passed `clipboardReadEnabled` to a `TaskOrchestrator` that lacked the parameter; this PR adds it and the gate it drives. Merged PR #94 per section 18.

Confirmed: the clipboard can hold another app's secret, so the opt-in, default-OFF gate matches the existing triage/speech pattern.
